title: Cauliflower and Tofu Stew with Quinoa
subtitle: fragrant with cardamom
description: Cauliflower, tomato and marinated tofu simmered with cardamom and cinnamon, served over fluffy quinoa.

steps.text: Place 1 cm cubes of tofu in a bowl with 1 tbsp soy sauce, a pinch of cinnamon and the crushed garlic and marinate for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

Heat the coconut oil in a pot and add the lightly cracked cardamom pods. Fry for 1 minute, then add the sliced onion, tomato wedges and tofu. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes over high heat, stirring, add 1 tbsp soy sauce, cover and cook for 10 minutes over medium heat.

Add the cauliflower florets, 2 tbsp soy sauce and the remaining cinnamon and stir. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for about 30 minutes, until the onion loses its crunch and the cauliflower is nearly completely soft.
Meanwhile, bring the quinoa and water to the boil in a small pot, add the salt, sesame oil and bay leaves, and cook covered over low heat until the water is absorbed, 18 minutes.
Serve the vegetable stew on a bed of quinoa.
